status.idle: Ready – click the tomato to start
status.idleBreak: %1 ready – click the tomato to start it
status.doneShort: Click the tomato to start the short break (%1 min)
status.doneLong: Click the tomato to start the long break (%1 min)
notify.workShort: Time for a short break (%1 min).
notify.workLong: Time for a long break (%1 min) – %2 sessions today!
set.fullscreenWarn: Warning: the break covers every window and game. You cannot open or use anything else meanwhile. Emergency exit: hold Esc for 3 seconds.
overlay.tip: Stand up, stretch, drink something, look into the distance.
overlay.escape: Emergency exit: hold Esc for 3 seconds
item.time.title: Time
item.time.desc: Phase and large remaining time with seconds.
item.progress.title: Progress
item.progress.desc: Bar showing how far the current phase is.
item.status.title: Status
item.status.desc: What is happening and when the phase ends.
item.cycle.title: Round
item.cycle.desc: Dots for the sessions until the long break.
item.today.title: Today
item.today.desc: Today's sessions and focus time, with a bar towards your daily goal.
item.controls.title: Buttons
item.notify.title: Notification
item.focusDnd.title: Focus mode
item.focusDnd.desc: Silences all other notifications during focus. Only the tomato speaks up. Everything is restored afterwards.
item.replayMissed.title: Catch up
item.replayMissed.desc: After focus, one notification lists what was silenced meanwhile.
item.muteAudio.title: Mute other audio
item.muteAudio.desc: Mutes audio during focus and unmutes it afterwards. If it was already muted, it stays muted.
item.stayAwake.title: Stay awake
item.stayAwake.desc: No screensaver and no lock while focus is running.
item.sound.title: Sound
item.sound.desc: Plays a sound when a phase ends. Pick which one in settings.
item.autoBreak.title: Auto breaks
item.autoBreak.desc: The break starts by itself after the tomato bursts.
item.autoWork.title: Auto focus
item.autoWork.desc: The next session starts by itself after the break.
item.fullscreenBreak.title: Fullscreen break
custom.allUsed: Everything is already on your card.
set.replayNeedsDnd: Only works together with focus mode.
custom.boxHint: Drag tiles into a box or click them. Drag back or ✕ removes them.
info.btn.primary.title: Start · Pause · Resume
info.btn.primary.desc: Starts the next phase or pauses the running one.
info.btn.reset.title: Reset
info.btn.reset.desc: Stops the phase. Pressed while idle, the round starts over.
info.btn.skip.title: Skip
info.btn.skip.desc: Jumps to the next phase: from focus to break, from break to focus.
info.btn.tomato.title: The tomato
info.btn.tomato.desc: Click to start, pause or resume. When a session is done, it bursts.
info.ui.customize.title: Customize
info.ui.customize.desc: Drag tiles into the left and right boxes, change grid size and box content.
info.ui.settings.title: History & settings
info.ui.settings.desc: Calendar with all sessions, durations, sounds and all features.
info.help.title: How it works
info.help.desc: Click a tile to switch it on or off, hover to read what it does. With ✎ Customize you take more tiles from the toolbox and drag them into the left and right boxes. There you also pick 2×2 or 3×3, or let a box show timer, stats or a calendar.
info.box.stats.title: Stats
info.box.stats.desc: Click to open the full history.
info.box.calendar.title: Calendar
info.box.calendar.desc: Click to open the full history.
info.edit.size.title: Grid size
info.edit.mode.title: Box content
info.edit.mode.desc: Switches between tiles, timer durations, stats and a mini calendar.
